description: This file defines socket helper functions, classes, and constants for testing socket operations within the starboard/nplb namespace. It includes function declarations for creating, accepting, reading, writing, and transferring sockets, as well as utility functions for timing and error checking, primarily used in testing scenarios.

classes.name: ConnectedTrio
classes.description: Holds a trio of sockets: listen, client, and server sockets for testing connection scenarios.

classes.name: ConnectedTrioWrapped
classes.description: Holds a trio of wrapped socket objects (smart pointers) for testing socket connections.

methods.name: IsUnspecified
methods.description: Checks if the given socket address is the unspecified address (all zeros).

methods.name: IsLocalhost
methods.description: Checks if the given socket address is the localhost address.

methods.name: GetPortNumberForTests
methods.description: Returns a consistent port number suitable for tests.

methods.name: CreateServerTcpSocket
methods.description: Creates a TCP server socket with reuse address option.

methods.name: CreateServerTcpSocketWrapped
methods.description: Creates a TCP server socket and returns it wrapped in a unique_ptr.

methods.name: CreateBoundTcpSocket
methods.description: Creates a TCP socket bound to all interfaces on a specified port.

methods.name: CreateBoundTcpSocketWrapped
methods.description: Creates and wraps a bound TCP socket.

methods.name: CreateListeningTcpSocket
methods.description: Creates a TCP socket listening on all interfaces on a specified port.

methods.name: CreateListeningTcpSocketWrapped
methods.description: Creates and wraps a listening TCP socket.

methods.name: AcceptBySpinning
methods.description: Accepts a connection on a listening socket with retries until timeout.

methods.name: AcceptBySpinning
methods.description: Overload accepting from a Socket object.

methods.name: WriteBySpinning
methods.description: Writes data to a socket, retrying until success or error.

methods.name: WriteBySpinning
methods.description: Overload writing to a Socket object.

methods.name: ReadBySpinning
methods.description: Reads data from a socket, retrying until success or error.

methods.name: ReadBySpinning
methods.description: Overload reading from a Socket object.

methods.name: Transfer
methods.description: Transfers data between two sockets, retrying until complete or error.

methods.name: Transfer
methods.description: Overload transferring between Socket objects.

methods.name: CreateAndConnect
methods.description: Creates and connects a trio of sockets (client, server, listener) for testing.

methods.name: CreateAndConnectWrapped
methods.description: Creates and connects wrapped socket trio.

methods.name: TimedWait
methods.description: Returns elapsed time in microseconds for a wait operation.

methods.name: TimedWaitTimed
methods.description: Returns elapsed time in microseconds for a wait with timeout.

methods.name: WaitShouldBlockBetween
methods.description: Checks that wait blocks between specified microsecond bounds.

methods.name: WaitShouldNotBlock
methods.description: Checks that wait does not block significantly.

methods.name: TimedWaitShouldNotBlock
methods.description: Checks that wait does not block longer than specified timeout.

methods.name: TimedWaitShouldBlock
methods.description: Checks that wait blocks at least the specified timeout.

methods.name: SocketErrorIn
methods.description: Checks if a socket error is in a set of expected errors.
